--- title: "Runtime and Ratings" --- # Film Runtime and IMDb Ratings This page examines whether film runtime is related to IMDb ratings. As shown in @fig-runtime-rating, the scatter plot compares the length of each film with its IMDb rating. ::: {#cell-fig-runtime-rating .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pandas as pd import matplotlib.pyplot as plt films = pd.read_csv("films.csv") plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5)) plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"]) plt.xlabel("Runtime (Minutes)") plt.ylabel("IMDb Rating (0-10)") plt.title("Film Runtime vs. IMDb Rating") plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3) plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![Relationship between film runtime and IMDb rating](runtime-rating_files/figure-html/fig-runtime-rating-output-1.png){#fig-runtime-rating width=663 height=449} ::: ::: ## Average IMDb Rating by Decade The following table displays the mean IMDb rating for films released in each decade. ::: {#7b1f322b .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10 decade_ratings = ( films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"] .mean() .round(2) ) decade_ratings.to_frame(name="Mean IMDb Rating") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}
